title: Stable Diffusion PNG Info: Read Prompts and Parameters | AICheck365
description: Read Stable Diffusion PNG info in your browser: the parameters chunk from A1111, ComfyUI prompt and workflow JSON, and NovelAI metadata. Free, with no upload.
h1: Stable Diffusion PNG Info Viewer: read prompts and parameters
eyebrow: High-intent tool guide · United States / English
lead: The useful evidence in a Stable Diffusion image is often inside the original PNG, not in its visual style. AICheck365 reads PNG text chunks locally and separates A1111 parameters, ComfyUI prompt/workflow JSON, NovelAI metadata, model details, seed, sampler, steps, CFG, and image size.

direct.heading: Quick answer: inspect the original PNG text chunks
direct.body: Open the direct PNG export and look for parameters, prompt, workflow, Comment, Description, or Software chunks. A1111 commonly stores a readable parameters block; ComfyUI commonly stores prompt and workflow JSON. These fields are strong workflow clues but are not signed, so they can be edited or removed.

evidenceRows: Best input. It can preserve tEXt, iTXt, and zTXt chunks written by the generation interface.
Usually weak input because the file has been re-encoded and the original text chunks are gone.
Useful reproducible metadata, but weaker than a valid signed C2PA manifest.
signalRows: Positive prompt, negative prompt, steps, sampler, CFG scale, seed, size, model, and model hash.
Node graph JSON, checkpoint and LoRA names, seed, sampler, scheduler, dimensions, and connections.
Software identifiers and generation settings when the original exporter preserved them.
Secondary descriptive fields; Stable Diffusion workflow data is more often in PNG text chunks.
steps: Use the PNG downloaded directly from the generation UI.
Open the PNG Parameter Extractor and wait for local parsing.
Search for parameters, prompt, workflow, model, seed, sampler, CFG, or size.
Treat the result as editable workflow evidence and record the source of the file.
limits: Metadata can be edited or copied into an unrelated PNG.
Screenshots, JPEG conversion, image optimizers, and social platforms commonly remove text chunks.
No parameters means only that this copy has no readable generation data; it does not prove a non-AI origin.
faq: Can I recover the prompt from any Stable Diffusion image?
Only when the original or a metadata-preserving copy still contains generation fields.
Is PNG info the same as EXIF?
No. A1111 and ComfyUI usually use PNG text chunks rather than camera EXIF tags.
Does the file leave my device?
No. Parsing happens locally in the browser.
